notes.title: Small update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

I'm just writing a quick post to say that I've made a small update to this VN to fix a handful of typos which were pointed out both in the Steam community hub and in my own Discord server. Ashes should be a more polished experience now, and I hope people enjoy it!

I've also added a Mac build so even more people can experience this VN.

As always, thank you for the continued support over the years; it's very much appreciated. If you find more bugs or spelling errors in this VN do let me know, and I will try to fix things in a reasonable timeframe!

- ebi x
